correctness.rationale: Complete proof from independent graded commutator equations. Rank-one determinantal locus dimension m+3; degree-three linear fibers dimension 3m+1; even center 8m. Explicit one-parameter curves prove closure, hence geometrically irreducible with dimension 12m+4. Genuine rank-one curves and polarization prove a reduced tangent-space lower bound 4m+tau(r,m)>4m+4 at every zero-degree-one point, all other points smooth. Zero/rank-one disjoint point counts prove finite-field formula. Separate characteristic-two case. Standalone checks enumerate F3 ranks and F3/F5 fibers, check tangent spans and GF4 products; these are corroboration not infinite proof. No statement about radicality of unreduced ideal.
